preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input `root` must be either a `TreeNode` instance or `None` (empty tree).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 100000 for node in [root] + [child for node in [root] if node else [] for child in [node.left, node.right] if child]) if root else True
preconditions.description: Every node's value in the tree must be an integer between 1 and 100000 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node.left, TreeNode) or node.left is None for node in [root] + [child for node in [root] if node else [] for child in [node.left, node.right] if child]) if root else True
preconditions.description: Every node's `left` child must be either a `TreeNode` instance or `None`.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node.right, TreeNode) or node.right is None for node in [root] + [child for node in [root] if node else [] for child in [node.left, node.right] if child]) if root else True
preconditions.description: Every node's `right` child must be either a `TreeNode` instance or `None`.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(sum(subset) for subset in subsets if all(not (a in subset and b in subset) for a in subset for b in [a.left, a.right, a.parent] if b)) if root else 0
postconditions.description: The returned value is the maximum possible sum of a subset of nodes where no two nodes in the subset are directly connected (i.e., no parent-child relationship exists between any two nodes in the subset). If the tree is empty (`root` is `None`), the sum is 0.
The returned value is a non-negative integer (since all node values are positive).
